item.tib: brnag pa las kyi drwa ba gshin rje rab tu 'khros pa'i rgyud las gshin rje'i zor bzlogs
item.coloph: dbal chen po gshed dmar spyi 'dul cha lag gshin rje 'khros pa'i rgyud las/ gshin rje zor gyis bzlog(gyi zlog)pa/ yum sras gshen gsum gyis (gyi) bka' nyan/ stag la me 'bar gyi phyag cha/ gsang ba'i man ngag rno mtshon dang 'dra ba rdzogs so//
